::: {#exr-triple-plus-power-check}
#### Checking a guess

A sequence starts with $e_0 = 1$, and has the recurrence relation (@def-recurrence-relation)

$$
e_n = 3 e_{n-1} + 2^n
\quad\text{for every integer } n \ge 1.
$$

Someone guesses the closed form (@def-closed-form) $e_n = 3^{n+1} - 2^{n+1}$.
Find $e_1$, $e_2$ and $e_3$ from the recurrence relation,
and check the guess for $n = 0, 1, 2, 3$.

:::
